content.text: Every DC machine has a stator (stationary) and a rotor/armature (rotating), separated by an air gap through which flux crosses.

Commutator analogy The commutator is a smart switch that flips connections every half revolution — always maintaining the same polarity at the terminals. It straightens the AC generated in the rotating coils into DC output.

Exam-ready — commutator function (full marks answer):
The commutator converts the alternating EMF induced in the rotating armature conductors into a unidirectional (DC) voltage at the external terminals by mechanically reversing the connections to the armature coils at the instant they pass through the magnetic neutral axis.

Common mistake — The mistake that loses a mark every exam "Laminations reduce hysteresis loss." WRONG. Laminations reduce eddy current loss . Hysteresis loss is reduced by using silicon steel . Different problem, different solution. Examiners test this every year.
